message.content:
The function writes three bytes into `s->buf` without checking whether `s->used` has enough remaining space in the 108-byte buffer. Since this is called once per SLC option received, repeated calls can overflow the buffer.

The primary bug is the unchecked write at line 18 (and the subsequent writes at 19–20), but the first out-of-bounds write occurs at line 18.

Answer: 18
